paragraphs: [Sanhedrin 17b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.17b.5) says that they are Rav Huna and Rav Chisda.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara and [Heilprin’s entry on the Elders of Sura](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2765&lang=en) both give Rav Huna and Rav Chisda for this expression.
